items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: this fellow that plays Cornet in their group, uh, a guy by the name of George Mitchell. He was, uh, he was a good Cornetist.

ctx.x: We were talking about Jolly Roll too. You listening to a lot of Jolly Roll?

Uh... Well, uh, I had one or two records with the, uh, the Hot Peppers, Red Hot Peppers. And, uh, this fellow that plays Cornet in their group, uh, a guy by the name of George Mitchell. He was, uh, he was a good Cornetist. I liked his style. And, uh, I'll say once before, he appears to be a musician that might have come from one of these orchestra pits. He plays that type of stuff, you know. He's good. He's really good.
I heard you play something one time on Lillingberg. It sounded like Paul Morell, but you said you never heard any of Paul Morell's stuff, huh?
